note: Behavioral decomposition evals (story-076) — the regression net for altitude. Given a prose feature, the skill must decompose into BUILDING BLOCKS (vertical, independently-demonstrable slices, may cross services), NOT task-slices by code layer (collection/field/endpoint/hook/migration). Grade the proposed build_hierarchy TREE (node titles + where the 'how' lives), not the prose around it. Guards story-074 (altitude guidance) + story-075 (altitude_warnings lint). Run by giving an agent the skill + the prompt, capturing the build_hierarchy it WOULD call (dry-run, no mutations), then checking the assertions.

evals.name: domain-tier-isolation (the MM case)
evals.prompt: Заведи фичу в архитекторе: изоляция домена по слоям. У группы есть слой L1/L2/L3; админ объявляет слой для группы; при логине гость редиректится на домен своего слоя. Сформируй дерево нод перед кодом.
expect_building_blocks: Гость попадает на домен своего слоя при логине
assertions: Top-level nodes name observable outcomes ("<actor> can <X>"), not artifacts.
No node is titled after a collection / field / endpoint / hook / migration (would draw an altitude_warning).
Implementation steps + file:line anchors live in the node description/acceptance, NOT as child nodes.
Each block passes the demo-test: the demo is 'admin can declare a tier' / 'guest lands on the right domain', not 'a collection now exists'.
An unverified integration premise (e.g. 'core reads via ACP-API') is filed as VERIFY/draft, not asserted as a confident block (story-078).

evals.name: svg-export (single block, resist over-splitting)
evals.prompt: Опиши фичу: экспорт диаграммы в SVG с сохранением позиций нод. Заведи в архитекторе.
assertions: This is ONE building block (one observable outcome: a user gets an SVG file) — the merge-test collapses serializer+button+endpoint into it; they are NOT separate sibling nodes.
Crossing front+back (button + endpoint + serializer) is NOT a reason to split — number of touched components is not a granularity signal.
Steps go into the description; a child node appears only if there is a separately-demonstrable sub-result.

evals.name: realtime-collab (epic with genuine multiple blocks)
evals.prompt: Realtime collaboration на канвасе: несколько пользователей видят правки друг друга вживую, видят курсоры, и при конфликте правок последний выигрывает. Сформируй ноды.
assertions: Multiple blocks are justified ONLY because each has a distinct observable demo (live edits / cursors / conflict resolution), not because the code has multiple layers.
Transport (WebSocket), presence store, CRDT are implementation of the blocks — they live in descriptions/acceptance, not as nodes.
Cross-cutting concerns (latency SLO, reconnect) are acceptance properties of the blocks or a cross-cutting epic, not feature nodes (story: cross-cutting ≠ feature).

evals.name: notifications (order = deps + releases, not stage-nodes)
evals.prompt: Уведомления: пользователь получает email при упоминании, и может отключить их в настройках. Сначала бэкенд-контракт, потом фронт. Заведи фичу.
assertions: "Сначала контракт, потом фронт" is expressed as a dependency + release assignment, NOT as стадии-узлы ('контракт' / 'бэкенд' / 'фронт').
Two blocks because two observable outcomes (receive email / mute), each shippable and demo-able on its own.
